notes: Independent review of all 40 Part C PNGs plus compose.py. Read BRIEF-17 in full, panel 1, COURSE.md and NOTES.md method sections; panel 2 is absent. No production file was edited. All pieces were inspected at literal 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x beside fantasy-house-2 in per-file/atlas proofs. Code confirmed all 40 native/4x per-file views exactly match current exports. Inspected self/compatible seams, rear stacks, C assemblies, props on approved summer ground and literal 3x3 repeats of all five street/lane/mud surfaces; selected props also at 8x. No seasonal partners belong to this set, so seasonal overlays and summer/seasonal alpha-mask comparisons are not applicable. Mechanical checks pass for every PNG: required/documented native dimensions, RGBA, alpha only 0/255, zero hidden RGB, no one- or two-pixel 8-connected alpha islands, square opaque architectural footprints. Every rear/side/corner wall has exact course rows 0/47; all roof caps have one-pixel dark top/side boundaries. These do not waive depth, repetition or assembly failures. Re-rendered the 768x576 L-block, 864x864 market, 768x480 5|1 and 1|5 test, and corner scene by importing unchanged compose.py with bytecode disabled. Scene pixels match supplied renders; fresh critic-r17C-1-* outputs include exact 1x/3x, comparisons beside both unscaled references, and greyscale squints at 1x. Current-town displays 24px cells; fantasy-house-2 is the native-scale comparator. Required L-roof rectangles are filled and garden ground is deliberate; no accidental transparent roof hole is alleged. Street shadows are present and the A/B firewall joins remain intact. Current fantasy church/hall, well and two stall drawings are labelled Part D proxies: their skyline hierarchy, absent gate and six distinct stalls remain deferred, not charged as C asset failures. No Round 15 scene asset is used; its street is comparison only and course/palette donors remain the established contract. Part A trade signs were not regraded. BRIEF-17 wins over panel suggestions to drop compulsory bends/jogs/wedges, defer the 24px lane, remove fixed courses or allow overlays outside lots. The user no-commit/push/branch-change instruction overrides the brief’s push instruction. Passed wall drawings are not approval of a faulty paired roof/upper-floor assembly; failures are assigned to components that need changing. Evidence: critic-r17C-1-assembly-*.png, -repeat-*.png, -prop-*.png, -seams-*-1x.png and rebuilt comparisons. The aggregate SHA-256 of all out/city17 files was unchanged before/after review: 8778727bd58cee1dbb341f797b4e20f0545b2cc92b2105360208b1eee52b44d3.
